definitions.explanation: To have the intended effect or result.

definitions.gloss: to be possible, to be able to
definitions.explanation: To be able to function or be done.

notes:
{効|き}く means to be effective or work.

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {効|き}く: to be effective
- {聞|き}く: to listen, hear, ask
- {利|き}く: to work, function

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {気|き}が{利|き}く: to be attentive/thoughtful
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く: to be flexible
- ブレーキが{効|き}く: brakes work
